column1: # K.O. Racing 3D - user interface text used by the Rust port.
# Three tab separated columns: key, text, source.
#   key     what the code asks for
#   text    what is drawn; {} is a placeholder, filled in order by labels::format
#   source  where the string comes from.  A number is the id the game itself
#           uses in its own /ui/ui.txt (aq.a(id) hands it to the font), and "-"
#           marks a string the original has no id for: the port added it for
#           the screens and features it has that the original does not.
# Keeping the text here rather than in Rust means the labels can be diffed
# against the game's file, corrected and translated without touching code.
